data.gender_notes: Ruhani is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ruhani is a name derived from the Arabic word 'ruh' meaning soul or spirit. This name is often used for girls in Islamic communities and is believed to represent a deep connection to the divine. The name Ruhani carries the meaning “Soul, Spirit” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ruhani usually hope their child will grow to embody soul, spirit and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ruhani is a name that signifies a deep spiritual connection to the divine. It is believed that those named Ruhani possess a strong intuition and a deep understanding of the world around them.
data.etymology: Ruhani belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soul, Spirit.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruhani total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
